context: Discovery call for a data audit service. Prospect: Quarry Foods, contact Anita Dole, finance director. Fixed fee $15,000, four weeks, report and one workshop included. Data stays in the client's own systems. References are available.

lines.text: hello anita and joel thanks for the time

lines.speaker: Anita
lines.text: hi sam we looked at the proposal and honestly fifteen thousand is more than we have ever paid for an audit
i hear that let me think about the framing of the scope

lines.speaker: Joel
lines.text: our last consultant took ten weeks instead of four and left us with a report nobody read
a report that nobody reads is a waste i agree

lines.speaker: Joel
lines.text: i am not comfortable with outsiders looking at our customer tables
the data stays in your systems so no copies leave

lines.speaker: Anita
lines.text: the board meets in march and nothing gets approved before that
a small first step would not need the board

lines.speaker: Anita
lines.text: a cheaper firm offered us the same thing for nine thousand
i would check that it is really the same scope

lines.speaker: Joel
lines.text: we have a freeze on new vendors until the end of the year
then the start date is the real question

lines.speaker: Anita
lines.text: joel is celebrating his birthday tomorrow so we are bringing cake

lines.speaker: Joel
lines.text: thanks i will save you a piece
